messages:
elaine: opened a docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — migration guide for v2 SDK + a small example snippet. Can someone from docs review? I'd like to set this to auto-merge once checks pass. cc @mira @sam

mira: thanks! quick note: CODEOWNERS will request reviews for changes under /docs/sdk/ by default. auto-merge needs the branch protection checks + the automerge app to be happy.

sam: what checks are currently failing on the preview?

elaine: build shows `ci/docs-build` ✅, but preview failed on `ci/linkcheck` with: 

```
LinkCheckError: 1 broken link found
  - /sdk/python/old-init -> 404
```

ci-bot: [docs-preview] build #342 failed — linkcheck reported 1 broken link. Full log: https://ci.internal/reports/342

mira: that broken link is from the migration doc referencing the old python init API. two options: update the link to the new path or add a redirect entry in netlify/_redirects. The latter is useful if we want to keep old inbound links working.

kevin: fwiw, the automerge app only merges when: all required checks pass, there are no pending CODEOWNERS reviews, and there is the `automerge:enabled` label. We recently added `docs-skip-review` label for trivial fixes but it only works for typos — not for migration guides.

sam: is there a way to get a timing window for merging? Some team members enable a merge freeze during major deploys.

mira: yes — we have a protected window: daily 09:00–11:00 PT no auto-merge. Outside that window automerge proceeds as long as checks clear. Also if the PR touches /api/ or /security paths, it always requires an explicit review.

elaine: ok I'll update the broken link to point to `/sdk/python/init-v2` and add a small note about redirects. I'll also add label `automerge:enabled` so the app can pick it up after CI passes.

automerge-bot: noted: will attempt merge when checks green and no CODEOWNERS pending.

mira: after you push the link fix, trigger a rerun of `ci/linkcheck` with the `Re-run jobs` button. If anything else pops up ping me and I'll review quickly. :thumbsup:

elaine: done — pushed fix and added `automerge:enabled`. Rerun started. Thanks!

ci-bot: [docs-preview] rerun #343 started

kevin: small suggestion for future: if the change is purely example code or fixes a single in-doc link, consider the `docs-skip-review` flow and a short PR description like `docs: fix broken link` so reviewers can triage faster.

elaine: good call. will do that for tiny fixes. For larger migration guides I'll request full review. Thanks all.
